extracted.name: Delicious Poppy Seed Dressing
extracted.description: This tangy, homemade honey mustard poppy seed dressing is sure to be a family favorite. It mixes up in minutes and is wonderful on any type of salad.
instruction_lines: Combine olive oil, vinegar, honey, onion, mustard, and salt in a blender; blend until well mixed. Stir in poppy seeds.
